about: The `pages_read` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 4 of 5 for fy 2014.

rows.proof: GRAND TOTAL, TOTAL column, the total row: $28,478,866 is the printed grand total of principal plus interest and it is right -- $22,140,229 + $6,338,637 foots exactly. It is NOT the sum of the per-year group TOTAL rows, which come to $27,438,162, because the document leaves two of those cells empty. The difference is $1,040,704, exactly the two cells attested on this page. Recorded as read, and excluded from the column check so that the hole stays visible rather than being absorbed.

TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30 2014, pages 40, 41 and 42. One table across three pages: fourteen debt issues, each with a PRINCIPAL, an INTEREST and a group TOTAL row, running FY2015-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. PAGES 40 AND 41 are written vertically and MIRRORED, like the trust pages: reverse each word, flip x, and the page transposes, so a constant-y band is a FISCAL YEAR and a constant-x run is a debt line. PAGE 42 is printed the ordinary way but its FIGURE columns sit one row pitch (11.2pt) BELOW the labels they belong to. That offset is measured, not assumed: at +11.2 the TOTAL column reproduces the sum of pages 40 and 41 for 37 of 41 rows, and at 0 or -11.2 almost nothing ties. WHAT CLOSES. Principal + interest = the group total for every one of the 197 (issue, year) cells where the document prints all three. The year-by-year schedule sums to the printed GRAND TOTAL EXACTLY, to the dollar, for both principal ($22,140,229) and interest ($6,338,637). GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL + GRAND TOTAL INTEREST = TOTAL DEBT in all 33 years. WHAT DOES NOT, AND WHY. The page prints WHOLE DOLLARS over figures carrying cents, so a column of rounded addends need not sum to its own rounded total: four row sums are out by exactly one dollar and never more. Every one of the four is an INTEREST row or a total containing interest; no principal figure drifts anywhere, which is what a cents-rounding artefact looks like and is why a $1 tolerance is carried here rather than a misread being suspected. TWO CELLS ARE DOCUMENT DEFECTS and are attested below rather than reconciled. Together they are $1,040,704, which is exactly the amount by which the per-year TOTAL rows fall short of the printed GRAND TOTAL -- so once both are accounted for the whole table ties to the dollar.

MASS WATER POOL 9* TOTAL column: the document prints $4,147,119 where principal $3,693,065 plus interest $872,758 is $4,565,823, short by $418,704. $418,704 is exactly the FY2024 principal payment on this issue, which page 40 prints on the PRINCIPAL row and leaves BLANK on the group TOTAL row -- so the TOTAL column is the sum of a row with a hole in it. Which figure the town intended is not established. Read 28 September 2026.
